# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are generally applied to the latest release line of DonutRTP for
Bukkit / Spigot / Paper / Purpur / Folia on Minecraft **1.20.1 through 26.2**.

Older releases may not receive backports.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately using GitHub Security Advisories for this
repository. Do not post exploit details in public issues or Discord until
maintainers have had a chance to investigate and release a fix.
